input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to YAML file describing the input data.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

assembly_options.title: Assembly options
assembly_options.description: Options relating to metagenomic de-novo assembly.

assembler.description: Which assembler to use for metagenome assembly.

enable_tiara.description: Enable domain-level classification of contigs with Tiara. If enabled, contigs classified using the categories listed in --exclude_tiara_classifications will be excluded from binning.

exclude_tiara_classifications.description: A comma-separated list of tiara classifications to use to exclude contigs from the assembly. Options are 'bacteria', 'archaea', 'prokarya', 'eukarya', 'organelle' or 'unknown'.

enable_genomad.description: Enable Genomad for classification of circular contigs for determination of plasmid status.

genomad_db.description: Path to a directory containing a Genomad database. If not provided, the database will be downloaded automatically.

genomad_splits.description: The number of chunks to split the Genomad database into when running searches. Increasing this value decreases memory usage at the expense of runtime.

read_mapping_options.title: Read mapping options
read_mapping_options.description: Options controlling the mapping of reads to the assembly for coverage estimation or Hi-C contacts.

long_read_mapping_reads_per_chunk.description: When mapping long reads, how many long reads to map to the assembly in a single chunk.

minimum_hifi_perc_identity.description: The minimum required percent identity of a read mapping to the assembly to be counted during coverage estimation for MetaBat2 and MaxBin2.

hic_aligner.description: Which Hi-C aligner to use - either bwa-mem2 or minimap2.

hic_mapping_cram_bin_size.description: When mapping Hi-C, map each CRAM file in slices of this size.

hic_mapping_minq.description: Minimum map quality for a Hi-C read to be passed on for binning by Metator.

binning_options.title: Binning options
binning_options.description: Options relating to binning of de-novo metagenome assemblies.

enable_binning.description: Enable binning of metagenomes into genome bins.

minimum_contig_size.description: The minimum size of contig to be considered when binning.

maximum_contig_size.description: The maximum size of contig to be considered when binning.

minimum_bin_size.description: The minimum size of a bin, in basepairs, to be emitted.

extract_circular_contigs.description: Extract circular contigs and treat them as bins.

minimum_circular_contig_length.description: The minimum length of a circular contig required to be treated as a bin.

semibin_environment_model.description: Pre-trained model to use with semibin for binning. Defaults to "global", see the SemiBin2 docs for full details: https://semibin.readthedocs.io/en/latest/usage/

hic_enzymes.description: A comma-separated list of Hi-C enzymes to use for binning with MetaTOR.

bin_refinement_options.title: Bin refinement options
bin_refinement_options.description: Options relating to the refinement of genome bins.

hmm_gtdb_pfam.description: Path to the GTDB r207 Pfam HMM database.

hmm_gtdb_tigrfam.description: Path to the GTDB r207 TigrFam HMM database.

bin_qc_options.title: Bin QC options
bin_qc_options.description: Options relating to the quality checking of genome bins.

enable_binqc.description: Enable quality checks of genome bins.

checkm2_db.description: Path to a local diamond database file for CheckM2. If not provided, the CheckM2 database will automatically be downloaded.

enable_trnascanse.description: Predict tRNAs in an assembly using tRNAscan-SE.

enable_rrna_prediction.description: Predict ribosomal RNA (rRNA) genes in assemblies using Infernal and the included Rfam covariance models.

rfam_rrna_cm.description: Covariance model for rRNA preditiction from RFAM.

bin_taxonomy_options.title: Bin taxonomy options
bin_taxonomy_options.description: Options relating to the taxonomic classification of genome bins.

enable_taxonomy.description: Enable taxonomic classification of genome bins.

gtdbtk_db.description: Path to a directory containing the GTDB-Tk database.

gtdbtk_skip_ani_screen.description: Skip the ANI screen check with skani when classifying genomes with GTDB-Tk.

gtdbtk_use_full_tree.description: Use the full bacterial phylogenetic tree when classifying bacterial genomes. This is enabled by default in the test profiles as it is required to use the mock database for testing. Enabling this with the full GTDB database requires a minimum of 320GB of memory for the GTDB-TK classify process, but will place all bins into a single tree.

gtdb_bac120_metadata.description: Path to the GTDB-Tk bac120 metadata file.

gtdb_ar53_metadata.description: Path to the GTDB-Tk ar53 metadata file.

gtdbtk_min_completeness.description: Minimum CheckM2 completeness required for a bin to be classified by GTDB-Tk.

gtdbtk_max_contamination.description: Maximum contamination allowed CheckM2 completeness for a bin to be classified by GTDB-Tk.

summary_options.title: Summary options
summary_options.description: General options relating to pipeline operation.

completeness_score.description: Multiplier for completeness when scoring bins for the bin summary. Used in formula (compleneness_score * completeness - contamination_score * contamination).

contamination_score.description: Multiplier for contamination when scoring bins for the bin summary. Used in formula (compleneness_score * completeness - contamination_score * contamination).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
